name: sync-canvas
description: SyncCanvas — a real-time collaborative whiteboard built with React, Excalidraw, Node.js, WebSockets, and PostgreSQL.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:server: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:client: npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
